description: This file defines the EmployeeTrackerModel class within the OrangeHRM performance API module. It is responsible for representing employee tracking data, including serialization and filtering mechanisms, in the context of performance tracking. The class uses traits and interfaces to facilitate normalization and data handling.

classes.name: EmployeeTrackerModel
classes.description: A model representing employee performance tracking data, used for API responses and data serialization.
